```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Global chunk options: show code by default
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Section 1: Load the independent validation data              -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```{r data-loading}
# ================== Path configuration ==================
# All paths below are resolved relative to this Rmd file's directory,
# so the whole project can be moved or cloned anywhere without editing.
# The project root should contain the two sub-directories below.
rmd_path <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
if (length(rmd_path) == 0L) {
  # Not knitting (e.g. running chunks directly in RStudio): current_input() has
  # no value, so fall back to the working directory, which RStudio sets to the
  # directory of this Rmd file.
  proj_dir <- getwd()
} else if (grepl("[.]Rmd$", rmd_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  # current_input() returned the full file path -> take its parent directory
  proj_dir <- dirname(rmd_path)
} else {
  # current_input() already returned the directory
  proj_dir <- rmd_path
}
data_dir  <- file.path(proj_dir, 'Independent_Data_Input')
param_dir <- file.path(proj_dir, 'Model_Parameters')

# Load required packages
library(readr)

# Read independent validation data (brain structure features + CBCL behavior)
brain <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, 'brain_aligned.csv'))
cbcl  <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, 'CBCL_aligned.csv'))

# Covariates (columns 2-3, used for regression prediction later)
cov <- brain[, 2:3]

# Brain feature matrix: drop leading columns (ID, covariates, etc.), keep numeric
brain_sub <- as.matrix(unname(brain[, 4:153]))

# CBCL behavior matrix: convert to integer
cbcl_sub <- apply(cbcl[, 4:120], 2, as.integer)
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Section 2: Load training-phase model parameters and scale    -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```{r load-model-parameters}
# Load standardization parameters saved from the training phase
# (centering means and scaling SDs)
load(file.path(param_dir, 'my_center.RData'))
load(file.path(param_dir, 'my_scale.RData'))
load(file.path(param_dir, 'cbcl_center.RData'))
load(file.path(param_dir, 'cbcl_scale.RData'))

# Load the trained CBCL regression models (to remove covariate effects)
load(file.path(param_dir, 'CBCL_trained_models.RData'))

# Load bootstrap stable features and sCCA candidate features
load(file.path(param_dir, 'u_boot_plot2000.RData'))
load(file.path(param_dir, 'v_boot_plot2000.RData'))
load(file.path(param_dir, 'scca_cand.RData'))

# Assign the loaded standardization parameters to the current environment
# (cbcl_center and cbcl_scale are already created directly by load())
brain_center <- my_center
brain_scale  <- my_scale

# Standardize brain features using the training means and SDs
# brain_sub <- scale(brain_sub)  # use this line instead for default scaling
brain_sub <- scale(brain_sub, center = brain_center, scale = brain_scale)
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Section 3: Remove covariate effects from CBCL (residuals)    -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```{r compute-cbcl-residuals}
# Regress each CBCL column on the covariates using the trained models,
# then take the residuals
cbcl_sub_residual <- sapply(1:ncol(cbcl_sub), function(i) {

  # Take the i-th model (matched by column order, not by name)
  fit <- CBCL_models[[i]]

  # Take the i-th column of the new data
  x <- cbcl_sub[, i]

  # Predict from the covariates
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = cov)

  # Return the residual (observed - predicted)
  x - pred
})

# Convert residuals back to a matrix (preserving rows and columns)
cbcl_sub_residual <- unname(cbcl_sub_residual)

# Standardize residuals using the training means and SDs
# cbcl_sub_residual <- scale(cbcl_sub_residual)  # use this instead for default scaling
cbcl_sub_residual <- scale(cbcl_sub_residual, center = cbcl_center, scale = cbcl_scale)
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Section 4: Extract brain loadings (sCCA weights + filtering) -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```{r extract-brain-loadings}
# Brain loading matrix (from the sCCA candidate result)
brain_loading <- scca.cand$u

# Flip the sign of dimensions 1 and 4 (to match the training phase)
brain_loading[, c(1, 4)] <- brain_loading[, c(1, 4)] * -1

# Keep only the bootstrap-stable features; set all others to 0
rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(brain_loading), u.boot.plot[[1]]$fea)
brain_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 1] <- 0

rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(brain_loading), u.boot.plot[[2]]$fea)
brain_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 2] <- 0

rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(brain_loading), u.boot.plot[[3]]$fea)
brain_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 3] <- 0

rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(brain_loading), u.boot.plot[[4]]$fea)
brain_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 4] <- 0
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Section 5: Extract behavior loadings (sCCA weights + filt.)  -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```{r extract-cbcl-loadings}
# Behavior loading matrix (from the sCCA candidate result)
cbcl_loading <- scca.cand$v

# Flip the sign of dimensions 1 and 4 (to match the training phase)
cbcl_loading[, c(1, 4)] <- cbcl_loading[, c(1, 4)] * -1

# Keep only the bootstrap-stable features; set all others to 0
rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(cbcl_loading), v.boot.plot[[1]]$fea)
cbcl_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 1] <- 0

rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(cbcl_loading), v.boot.plot[[2]]$fea)
cbcl_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 2] <- 0

rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(cbcl_loading), v.boot.plot[[3]]$fea)
cbcl_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 3] <- 0

rows_to_modify_vect1 <- setdiff(1:nrow(cbcl_loading), v.boot.plot[[4]]$fea)
cbcl_loading[rows_to_modify_vect1, 4] <- 0
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Section 6: Compute brain and behavior canonical scores       -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```{r compute-scores}
# Brain canonical scores = standardized brain features %*% brain loadings
brain_loading <- as.matrix(brain_loading)
brain_score <- brain_sub %*% brain_loading
# brain_score <- brain_score[, -4]  # uncomment to drop dimension 4

# Behavior canonical scores = standardized residuals %*% behavior loadings
cbcl_loading <- as.matrix(cbcl_loading)
cbcl_score <- cbcl_sub_residual %*% cbcl_loading
# cbcl_score <- cbcl_score[, -4]  # uncomment to drop dimension 4
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Section 7: Cross-dataset validation - correlation & FDR      -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->

```{r test-correlations}
# Correlate brain vs behavior canonical scores separately for each dimension
c1 <- cor.test(cbcl_score[, 1], brain_score[, 1])
c2 <- cor.test(cbcl_score[, 2], brain_score[, 2])
c3 <- cor.test(cbcl_score[, 3], brain_score[, 3])
c4 <- cor.test(cbcl_score[, 4], brain_score[, 4])

# Extract correlation coefficients, p-values, and CI bounds
r_vals  <- c(c1$estimate, c2$estimate, c3$estimate, c4$estimate)
p_raw   <- c(c1$p.value, c2$p.value, c3$p.value, c4$p.value)
ci_low  <- c(c1$conf.int[1], c2$conf.int[1], c3$conf.int[1], c4$conf.int[1])
ci_high <- c(c1$conf.int[2], c2$conf.int[2], c3$conf.int[2], c4$conf.int[2])

# BH (Benjamini-Hochberg) FDR correction
p_fdr <- p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH")

# Summarize results into a table
res_df <- data.frame(
  dimension = 1:4,
  r         = round(r_vals, 3),
  ci_lower  = round(ci_low, 3),
  ci_upper  = round(ci_high, 3),
  p_raw     = round(p_raw, 4),
  p_fdr     = round(p_fdr, 4)
)
print(res_df)
```
